|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Frostbite (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on the Hoth system if you control 2 exterior Hoth sites. During each of your control phases, retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site controlled by your unique (•) combat vehicle. Canceled if opponent controls this system. ( [Immune to Alter] if you occupy the 1st marker.)”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique (•) combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' removed “the”; “2” → “two”; removed “each of”; “phases,” → “phase, may”; “controlled by your” → “you control with a”; “Canceled if” → “If”; “system. ( [Immune to Alter] if” → “system, this Effect lost. While”; removed “the”; “marker.)” → “marker, (Immune to Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 07. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Frostbite]].
